name: 节理（密度/走向/充填）统计

map.按测线条带（scanline）统计节理：每行录入一条测线的长度与该测线上的节理条: Count joints along a scanline: enter the length of each survey line and the number of joints on it, compute the linear density (joints/m) and average spacing (m/joint) of each line, and aggregate them into an overall density as an aid to rock-mass integrity assessment; data is processed only locally in the browser and is not uploaded.
map.线密度 λ = 节理条数 / 测线长度（条/m） · 平均间距 x̄ = 1 /: Linear density λ = joint count / survey-line length (joints/m)　·　average spacing x̄ = 1 / λ = survey-line length / joint count (m/joint)
map.测线数据（每行一条：测线长度(m),节理条数）: Survey-line data (one per line: survey-line length (m), joint count)
map.📚 深度解析：节理（密度/走向/充填）统计与优势方位: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Joint (Density/Strike/Filling) Statistics and Preferred Orientation
map.节理密度：统计测线或露头上单位长度的节理数，评岩体完整性: Joint density: count the joints per unit length on a survey line or outcrop to assess rock-mass integrity
map.优势走向：对节理走向数据做统计，确定优势节理组与 Rosivo 图: Preferred strike: statistically analyse joint strike data to determine the dominant joint set and the rose diagram
map.边坡参考：结合产状与充填判定控制性结构面，辅助边坡稳定分析: Slope reference: combine attitude and filling to identify the controlling structural plane, aiding slope stability analysis
map.算法：输入一组节理数据（如线密度 条/m、或走向角度序列），自动得数据量 n、均: Algorithm: enter a set of joint data (such as a linear density in /m, or a series of strike angles) to automatically obtain the count n, mean,
map.。线密度=节理数/测线长，完整岩石常 <1 条/m、破碎带可达 5–10 条/m: . Linear density = joint count / survey-line length; intact rock is often <1 /m while a crushed zone can reach 5-10 /m (computed locally, no data uploaded).
map.例：某边坡 5 条测线节理线密度（条/m）3.2, 4.0, 2.8, 5.1,: Example: on a slope, five survey lines have joint linear densities (joints/m) 3.2, 4.0, 2.8, 5.1, 3.5 → n=5, mean=3.72 joints/m, median=3.5 joints/m, standard deviation σ=0.84 joints/m, range=2.3 joints/m. A high linear density (>3 joints/m) indicates a fairly fractured rock mass, and the slope must be checked against multiple controlling joint planes.
map.线密度和体积节理数怎么换算？: How do the linear density and volumetric joint count convert?
map.线密度是 1D 测量，体积节理数 Jv（条/m³）需三维统计。线密度高一般预示: The linear density is a 1D measurement; the volumetric joint count Jv (joints/m³) requires 3D statistics. A high linear density generally indicates a large Jv and a low RQD, but a precise Jv requires 3D statistics per the ISRM standard.
map.充填物对稳定性影响大吗？: Does the filling strongly affect stability?
map.大。泥质/绿泥石充填的节理抗剪强度远低于无充填，遇水易泥化滑动。统计时应记录充填: Yes. Joints filled with clay or chlorite have a shear strength far lower than unfilled ones and easily soften and slip when wet. The filling type and thickness should be recorded during statistics; this tool only computes density, and stability must be judged together with the material and attitude.
map.节理（密度/走向/充填）统计。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全: Joint (Density/Strike/Filling) Statistics. A free online tool, processed fully client-side, with no data uploaded, protecting your privacy.
